title.description: A short, human headline for this change (not a commit message).

intent.description: Why this change exists: the problem or goal it addresses.

context.description: Background a reviewer needs before looking at any code: what existed before, what constraints applied.

summary.description: A high-level narrative of what changed, in prose, without quoting code.

attention_points.description: Notable risks, trade-offs, or things the reviewer should pay special attention to overall.

role.description: This step's role in the overall change, e.g. 'foundation', 'core logic', 'wiring', 'tests'.

explanation.description: Why this change was made this way, explained to a reviewer.

path.description: Repo-relative path of a file touched in this step, exactly as it appears in the diff.

note.description: Optional short note about this specific file's part in the step.
